vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被强驱散的效果（含多数眩晕）
降低目标护甲
降低目标的攻击力
使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
攻击伤害波及周围单位
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
使隐身单位显形，不等于持续真视
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
缩短自身受到的控制与减益的持续时间（如散夜对剑+16%）
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
召唤有血量的单位（可控或不可控都算），以及夺取已有单位的控制权；按受攻击次数计算的单位和死亡守卫不算
能摧毁树木
可看见隐身单位

objects.subject: slardar_slithereen_crush
objects.description_zh: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并眩晕。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
objects.description_en: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.

shard.zh: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。
shard.en: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.

objects.subject: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
objects.description_zh: 斯拉达在水洼、水迹或河道中将获得移动速度、生命恢复、攻击力和护甲加成。
objects.description_en: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.

scepter.zh: 在水洼、水迹或河道中获得额外生命恢复、护甲，还有状态抗性。水洼/水迹的作用范围提升%scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%%，水洼的持续时间提升%scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%秒。
scepter.en: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.

objects.subject: slardar_amplify_damage
objects.description_zh: 削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示隐身单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
objects.description_en: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.

objects.subject: tidehunter_gush
objects.description_zh: 召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
objects.description_en: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.

scepter.zh: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。
scepter.en: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

objects.subject: tidehunter_kraken_shell
objects.description_zh:
加厚潮汐猎人的外皮，可以被动格挡物理伤害。对非英雄单位的格挡伤害有所减少。潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过临界值后还将移除负面的状态效果。

可以主动开启，以%active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%%移动速度的代价使伤害格挡量加倍。持续%active_duration%秒。

驱散类型：强驱散
objects.description_en:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

objects.subject: tidehunter_anchor_smash
objects.description_zh: 潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + %additional_range%。
objects.description_en: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
notes_zh: 锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

objects.subject: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
objects.description_zh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚%chain_length%距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至%max_movement_speed%，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚承受%attacks_to_destroy%次英雄攻击后会被摧毁。
objects.description_en: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.

objects.subject: tidehunter_ravage
objects.description_zh: 猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并眩晕附近所有敌方单位。
objects.description_en: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
notes_zh: 毁灭以%speed%的速度向外扩散。

objects.subject: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
objects.description_zh: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，眩晕击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
objects.description_en: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
notes_zh: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。

objects.subject: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
objects.description_zh: 巫医集中魔力治疗附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
objects.description_en: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.

objects.subject: witch_doctor_gris_gris
objects.description_zh: 巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的%death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每%gold_tick_interval_tooltip%秒会增加1金。右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。
objects.description_en: Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.  Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

objects.subject: witch_doctor_death_ward
objects.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。死亡守卫拥有%bonus_accuracy%%%额外必中率。
objects.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
notes_zh: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。

scepter.zh: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。
scepter.en: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

objects.subject: riki_smoke_screen
objects.description_zh: 丢下一个烟雾弹，沉默其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
objects.description_en: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
notes_zh: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。

shard.zh: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低%armor_reduction%点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。
shard.en: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.

objects.subject: riki_blink_strike
objects.description_zh: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成%slow_pct_tooltip%%%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。
objects.description_en: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

objects.subject: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
objects.description_zh: 持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的%interval_targets%个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
objects.description_en: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离至%AbilityCastRange%。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有%scepter_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升%scepter_bonus_duration%秒，并且额外发动%scepter_bonus_attacks%次攻击。
scepter.en: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.

objects.subject: riki_innate_backstab
objects.description_zh: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。
objects.description_en: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes_zh: 反补友方单位时具有%ally_multiplier%%%效果。
力丸的幻象也会有背刺的动作，但是不会造成额外伤害。

objects.subject: riki_backstab
objects.description_zh: 力丸遁入阴影，变为隐身状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。
objects.description_en: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

objects.subject: enigma_malefice
objects.description_zh: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被眩晕。每%tick_rate%秒眩晕一次。
objects.description_en: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.

shard.zh: 憎恶的眩晕时间增加%shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%秒，并且每次眩晕都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。
shard.en: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

objects.subject: enigma_demonic_conversion
objects.description_zh: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的%current_health_pct%%%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。
objects.description_en: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

objects.subject: enigma_midnight_pulse
objects.description_zh: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成%base_damage% + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
objects.description_en: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。

objects.subject: enigma_black_hole
objects.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
objects.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.

scepter.zh: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位%scepter_pct_damage%%%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个%scepter_radius%范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为%scepter_drag_speed%。
scepter.en: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.

objects.subject: tinker_laser
objects.description_zh: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
objects.description_en: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.

scepter.zh: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。
scepter.en: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

objects.subject: tinker_march_of_the_machines
objects.description_zh: 征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
objects.description_en: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
notes_zh: 机器人的产生速率是每秒%machines_per_sec%个。

scepter.zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。
scepter.en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.

objects.subject: tinker_deploy_turrets
objects.description_zh: 在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。
objects.description_en: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.

objects.subject: tinker_warp_grenade
objects.description_zh: 向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续%debuff_duration%秒。目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
objects.description_en: Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
notes_zh: 最大传送距离为%warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。
